items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 20 at 2:58PM EST until November 22 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 7 feet expected in the surf
zone.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Coastal Pender, Coastal New Hanover
and Coastal Brunswick Counties. In South Carolina, Coastal
Horry and Coastal Georgetown Counties.

* WHEN...From 7 PM this evening to 7 PM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 20 at 2:53PM EST until November 21 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25 kt
with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 5 to 7 ft. For the Gale Warning,
northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 5
to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Little River Inlet to Murrells
Inlet SC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 9 AM EST Saturday.
For the Gale Warning, from 9 AM Saturday to 4 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
